scripts.build:css: npm run build:scss && tailwindcss -i src/input.css -o static/style.css
scripts.build:css:watch: sass sass/custom.scss static/custom.css --watch & tailwindcss -i src/input.css -o static/style.css --watch
scripts.build:css:minify: sass sass/custom.scss static/custom.css --style compressed && tailwindcss -i src/input.css -o static/style.css --minify
